expected_improvement: Four horses should be easier to verify because the retry prompt asks for four separate, full-body horses with visible gaps and no extras.
The cats chasing the horses should be clearer because the retry prompt uses a left-to-right action layout with cats behind the horses, facing and running toward the horses.

Emphasize exact counts, full-body separation, visible gaps, and negative constraints against extra or merged animals and instruments.
regression_risks: Adding stronger foreground/background depth could hide the violins, so require all four wooden violins to remain visible and distinct behind the horses.
Emphasizing motion could reduce count clarity, so require all cats and horses to be full-body, separated, and countable.
Adding negative constraints could accidentally remove required objects, so restate all exact counts and required attributes.
repair_constraints: Show exactly four horses, each as a separate full-body horse with visible gaps between them; do not merge horses and do not add extra horses.
Show the three striped cats behind the horses, running toward the horses in the same direction, so the cats clearly appear to be chasing the horses.
Place the four horses in the foreground directly in front of the four wooden violins, with the violins behind the horses in the background but still fully recognizable and countable.

Keep exactly three striped cats, exactly four horses, and exactly four wooden violins. Make every cat, horse, and violin unobstructed enough to count. No extra cats, no extra horses, no extra violins, and no merged or duplicated animals or instruments.
